name: openai-compatible
description: Register any OpenAI-compatible provider (LiteLLM, Ollama, vLLM, LocalAI, …) in Oh-My-Pi. Supply the provider name, base URL, and API key; the installer lists available models and writes the provider into ~/.omp/agent/models.yml with runtime model discovery. The API key is stored chmod 600 in ~/.omp/<name>.key, never written inline or exported to shell profiles.
